_about: Public-domain August Dillmann (1823-1894), Berlin Old Testament scholar and Ethiopic philologist, for the Word Hoard: Genesis Critically and Exegetically Expounded (2 vols, Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1897), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

dillmann-genesis-1: Genesis critically and exegetically expounded, vol. 1 (Edinburgh : T. & T. Clark, 1897)
dillmann-genesis-2: Genesis critically and exegetically expounded, vol. 2 (Edinburgh : T. & T. Clark, 1897)

_excluded.dillmann-other: The Book of Enoch (1893, R. H. Charles's translation from Dillmann's text, Charles's book); the Ethiopic Grammar (1907, a grammar, not theology; left for later); Latin and Ethiopic editions
